title: Emerald Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document explains Emerald Saver Account daily limits: mobile check deposits are capped at $7,500 per calendar day, and total transfers out (scheduled and immediate) via mobile/online are capped at $15,000 per day. It also covers how deposits/transfers count toward limits and how to avoid rejection by checking remaining limit in digital banking and splitting activity across days.
